articles.summary: Engineers and purchasers face reduce time-to-market pressure by developing products rapidly and with high quality. This pressure drives suppliers to evolve beyond simply providing products and offer world-class multi-channel support. In today's digital world, where the internet makes information readily available, customers expect much of that support to come from digital or online resources.
articles.title: How Digital Transformation Helps Customers Accelerate Design and Time-to-Market
